X vs Y — X wins on the census and on question (c). True site set is 7 (deploy-now:89, ship-land:1739, operator-readout:534, cc-do:184, cc-do:359, cc-do:454, cc-premise:1392); X found 6, Y found 5. Y then compounds it with a flat exclusivity claim on (c) — "the only unattended/scheduled entry point … Outside the three scoped trees" — which I refuted from code: launchd/com.chrisren.autonomy-sweep.plist:26 (StartInterval 300) → scripts/autonomy-sweep.sh:1427/:1429/:1488 → bin/cc-premise:1392 runs deploy-live's own stored --falsify-host falsifier on a 6-hour cadence, inside scope. X hedges (c) correctly and adds a 5-item stale-citation audit I verified line-by-line (including deploy-live.sh:1679's ":540" → actual :658-661, unique to X). Y's genuine wins — the sole discovery of the grep-invisible ship-land.sh:1739 Popen with every detail right, and a near-miss census whose ~26 sampled citations were all accurate — are real and nearly close the gap, but one more missed site plus a contradicted key item on the exact question the brief singles out decides it.

X vs Z — Z, narrowly, on two specific verified differences. Both found the identical 6 sites and both missed ship-land.sh:1739 (both disclosing it as unread), and both are citation-clean on everything I opened. Z is cleanly correct on key item N4 where X is only hedged: Z separates "the only scheduled entry point that performs a REAL ADVANCE is outside scope" from the in-scope unattended decision-only paths (the Stop-hook dry-run and --falsify-host from claim/sweep), while X calls the same thing "one unverified possibility". Z also carries a material verified insight X lacks: the --dry-run --offline probe at sites 2 and 3 is not write-free, because link_refresh is called unconditionally at deploy-live.sh:1952 ahead of the fetch and reaches copy_drift_notice (:1493), whose body (:1350-1425) has no DRY_RUN guard and writes $PAGES_DIR/deploy-copy-drift.page at :1422 and the marker at :1423 — I confirmed all of it. X's counterweights are one extra verified stale citation and Z's one soft miscite (citing the comment at cc-premise:1412-1419 rather than the returning code at :1453-1460), which do not outweigh a cleanly-hit key item plus a verified novel finding.
